name: Far Voxels
definition: A hierarchical level-of-detail (HLOD) structure for massive model visualization that uses voxels to create coarse representations of sub-models, yielding interactive rates by handling levels of detail, culling, occlusion, and out-of-core storage.
summary: Far Voxels is a hierarchical level-of-detail technique that renders massive models efficiently by replacing distant geometry with direction-aware voxel blocks, distinguishing itself through environmental occlusion culling and multi-directional material interpolation.
